notes: The gapped first colon is resolved under rule 34's pro-verb sentence rather than as a supplied lexical verb, because the Hebrew writes שָׁמַע within the coordination; the head is on the first English occurrence, and heading on t011 (the occurrence standing in the verb's own colon) remains the named alternative.
